visual_style: Vertical 9:16, crisp warm daylight, energetic realistic cinematic look with named camera moves. Pakistani settings: government schools with whitewashed walls, plain green blackboards with no writing, wooden desks, pupils in school uniform. Modest dress. No on-screen text, letters, captions, logos or watermarks anywhere in the frame; papers and screens are blurred and unreadable. Recipe v2: in shots 1 and 5 the on-screen presenter speaks to the camera; in shots 2-4 an unseen narrator speaks as a voice-over and nobody on screen speaks.

narrator.name: presenter and voice-over
narrator.description: On screen in shots 1 and 5: a confident young Pakistani male teacher in a white shalwar kameez and a dark waistcoat, speaking Urdu to the camera with a lively, quick, enthusiastic delivery. Shots 2-4: an unseen Pakistani woman narrator, lively and quick, voice-over only.

shots.visual: At a busy Pakistani bazaar fruit stall, a confident young Pakistani male teacher in a white shalwar kameez and a dark waistcoat holds up a shopping receipt, frowns at it, then turns to the camera with a grin; quick push-in from medium shot to close-up.
Fast crane move from overhead down to desk level in a bright classroom: pupils in uniform arrange coloured counters and fraction tiles on their desks while a teacher guides them.
Energetic tracking shot along a corridor wall where pupils pin up hand-drawn bar charts, then a whip-pan to a pupil pointing proudly at one.
Handheld dolly in a staff room: young trainee teachers solve a problem together on a small whiteboard, and one punches the air when they get it right.

In a sunlit school corridor, a confident young Pakistani male teacher in a white shalwar kameez and a dark waistcoat walks briskly toward the camera, holds up a phone with a blurred screen and smiles; fast push-in to a close-up as pupils walk past softly in the background.

narration: بازار میں discount، بجلی کا بل، کلاس کا result۔ کیا آپ numbers پر بھروسہ کرتے ہیں؟
اس کورس میں آپ numerical اور algebraic reasoning، proportions اور logical thinking سیکھیں گے۔
tables، graphs اور data کو پڑھنا، اور اصل زندگی کے مسائل حل کرنا۔
چھ units، تاکہ آپ اپنے طلبہ کو بھی سوچ سمجھ کر حساب لگانا سکھا سکیں۔
پورا کورس مفت پڑھیں textbook ڈاٹ کام ڈاٹ پی کے پر۔ لنک نیچے ہے۔
